author: [deleted]
body:
What is your specilization and which skills do you use in the arena? Back when I was at your tier I would one shot nearly everyone with fully charged Sorrow III.
Your gear also seems to be lacking in defence, a lot of the opponents that you are going to be fighting againts will be melee/physical damage dealers so you are going to benefit from swapping a piece of your gear to be a  it more defense oriented.

Unfortunately, there arent much you can do at early levels  other than playing the game normally. Participating constantly in Kingdom raids, killing bosses in the overworld, fight in the arena and do gauntlets whenever you can. Btw try out the Berserk spec, it is quite powerful to the point where you probably wont even bother to change it up until tier 9.

author: IdTyrant
body: Go in with a fully charged Sorrow III and wear immunity to stun, sleep, etc anything that will interrupt you, and you should be able to one shot them if you can survive 2 turns

author: jethroguardian
body: Get a weapon maxed to level 10.  Don't replace it until you've gotten a better weapon maxed to level 10.

body:
FWIW, I lost nearly every battle in the Arena from t5-t9; I can count on one hand how many wins I had until I hit t10. Then I started to win like 70%+ of battles

I think when you're actively playing the game, the people who have been in the same tier for months or even years will naturally have upgraded gear that makes it impossible to beat when you're zooming through the tiers and don't have Masterforged Ornate gear all over the place.

author: WriterAny
body: If you’re short on Orns then kill some Ankou and wear the reaper robes, the ornate reaper robe is an extra 31.25% orns I believe. Then if you find the regular mob Headless, they’ll drop a Lost Helm that ranges from 5-31% extra orns. I run these together along with other items for a farming gear set. I’m nearing T9 and have 15 million orns already in holding.

author: maryisdead
body:
Like most have said: A charged *Sorrow III* and protection against common interrupts. Should win you most fights.

Some additional pointers:

* Don't waste time on using buffs, debuffs or anything. *Sorrow III* will one-shot almost everything.
* Keep your strongest elemental and non-elemental attack spells at hand. That should be *Multi-spark* (or whatever faction you are) and *Magic strikes*. Will come in handy to finish off enemies that have abilities like *Second Chance*.
* You might wanna keep *Golem's Fortitude* or some kind of Ward generation in your spell pool. I usually pop these for summoners as their pets can be problematic.
* Get a good PvP pet. *Wisp* sucks a$$. Imho the best thing you can get in your tier is *Scary Skeleton*. It's just so good. I'm T8 and still switch to it sometimes. *Death Worm* is an okay pet for PvP as is *Living Sword*.
* Sometimes you just lose. There's still RNG going on and you might just get the short end of the stick. I don't care in arena fights, but in kingdom wars it can be kinda disheartening.

Special note on summoners: I find these uncomfortable to fight, at least in my tier. In PvP I still find them broken and just wing it. I usually decide based on their HP and if I can bring them down in at most two turns with regular spells or still try *Somorrow III*. Kinda hit or miss with these.
